name: Elder Ray Bull Power below -200 trigger with 7%/7% TP/SL
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: EMA(14), Elder Ray Bull Power, DayHigh
entry_long: Compute Bull Power relative to EMA(14); when Bull Power (nRes) < Trigger (-200) pos=1 ("Trade reverse" input true flips direction): enter long market.
entry_short: Mirrored short when condition inverted (reverse mode).
exit: Exit at +7% take profit or -7% stop loss from entry close (strategy.exit with limit/stop).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Trigger -200 is price-unit dependent (BTC-like prices); not Elder Triple Screen. Reverse mode semantics need script check.
